about: Tolerances of qa/lipsync.py (BP-133, SyncNet). lipsync_max_ms and lipsync_review_frames are NOT here: they are read from the registry (SR.T BP-133). A null value means 'no sourced number yet' and the validator says NOT_RUN, never PASS.

conf_min.note: REVIEW-level default, not binding until the owner has seen it. Open: calibrate on clips he accepts as in sync and rejects as out of sync (none labelled yet).

min_track_frames.note: REVIEW-level default, not binding until the owner has seen it. null = SyncNet's own default (100 frames = 4 s at 25 fps). Open: shorter speaking shots stay NOT_RUN until the owner decides after one free measurement.
